item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus las khams gsum rigs drug sdug bsngal gyi gnas 'dren thugs rje'i lcags
item.coloph: zhes mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi sgo nas sgrib pa sbyong pa'i las tshogs gnas 'dren thugs rje lcags kyu 'di ni/ 'gro la rnam par brtse ba'i mched grogs slob ma 'ga' yis bskul ba la brten nas/ gshen gyi rnal 'byor kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying pos shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug mdun sa chen po ngo mtshar nor bu'i gling du/ sing zhing zla ba bu ga'i rgyal ba gsum pa ru sug bris su thon pa ris drug gnas nas 'dren pa'i thugs rje chen po'i lcags kyu ru gyur cig
